events.label: Myanmar military-orchestrated election installs Min Aung Hlaing as president

slots.name: president
slots.sentence: In late April, following a military-orchestrated election that installed junta chief Min Aung Hlaing as president, authorities said Suu Kyi had been moved to house arrest.
